question: How many orders did the customer Nova Motors SA place?
reference_sql: SELECT count(*) AS orders FROM sales.orders o JOIN sales.customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE c.name = 'Nova Motors SA'
second_sql:
SELECT count(*) AS order_count
FROM sales.orders o
JOIN sales.customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE c.name = 'Nova Motors SA'

question: How many Docking Stations were sold in completed orders?
reference_sql: SELECT sum(l.quantity) AS units FROM sales.order_lines l JOIN sales.orders o ON o.order_id = l.order_id JOIN sales.products p ON p.product_id = l.product_id WHERE p.name = 'Docking Station' AND o.status = 'completed'
second_sql:
SELECT SUM(ol.quantity) AS docking_stations_sold
FROM sales.order_lines ol
JOIN sales.orders o ON ol.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN sales.products p ON ol.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE o.status = 'completed'
  AND p.name ILIKE '%Docking Station%'

question: How many orders placed in 2025 were not cancelled?

question: What was the revenue from Edge Servers in 2025?
reference_sql: SELECT round(sum(l.quantity * l.unit_price * (1 - l.discount_pct / 100)), 2) AS revenue FROM sales.order_lines l JOIN sales.orders o ON o.order_id = l.order_id JOIN sales.products p ON p.product_id = l.product_id WHERE p.name = 'Edge Server' AND o.status = 'completed' AND o.ordered_on >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND o.ordered_on < DATE '2026-01-01'
second_sql:
SELECT SUM(ol.quantity * ol.unit_price * (1 - ol.discount_pct / 100)) AS revenue
FROM sales.orders o
JOIN sales.order_lines ol ON ol.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN sales.products p ON p.product_id = ol.product_id
WHERE o.status = 'completed'
  AND p.name = 'Edge Servers'
  AND o.ordered_on >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND o.ordered_on < DATE '2026-01-01'

question: How many 27-inch monitors were sold in completed orders in 2024?
reference_sql: SELECT sum(l.quantity) AS units FROM sales.order_lines l JOIN sales.orders o ON o.order_id = l.order_id JOIN sales.products p ON p.product_id = l.product_id WHERE p.name = 'Monitor 27in' AND o.status = 'completed' AND o.ordered_on >= DATE '2024-01-01' AND o.ordered_on < DATE '2025-01-01'
second_sql:
SELECT SUM(ol.quantity) AS total_sold
FROM sales.orders o
JOIN sales.order_lines ol ON ol.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN sales.products p ON p.product_id = ol.product_id
WHERE o.status = 'completed'
  AND o.ordered_on >= DATE '2024-01-01'
  AND o.ordered_on < DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND p.name ILIKE '%27-inch%monitor%'

question: Which APAC sales reps were hired in 2024? List their names.
